_incident: npm preinstall loader whose payload lives in the tarball (000webhost-admin@999.9.9, discovered 2024-12-14)
_note: The dominant npm malicious-intent shape in the public corpus: a throwaway package whose only manifest tell is `preinstall: node index.js`. The registry metadata DepWall reads is CLEAN of exfil patterns — the payload is inside index.js in the tarball, which the npm path never fetches. Verdict is therefore ASK (lifecycle script present + new/low-adoption), never BLOCK. This is the npm analogue of the pip/cargo build-script body scan: same attack, one ecosystem has the body, the other does not. KNOWN GAP — see notes.md. Metadata reproduced verbatim except the publisher identity, which is redacted.
